subject: ddl: init global vars from system tables before start domain (#54913)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, limited to `pkg/expression/...` and `pkg/session/...`. The session bootstrap now loads required global vars from system tables (notably system time zone / collation flag) before starting the domain/DDL loops, and bootstrap sessions explicitly start+close a temporary domain during bootstrap/upgrade. The expression change only fixes an assertion message argument mismatch. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; later history up to `upstream/master` does not indicate an unfixed correctness regression in the touched session/expression behavior.
